embeds.title: OpenInference is saving OpenRouter users $102.1K a year over CrofAI on DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
embeds.description:
OpenInference posts 0.03 / 0.007 / 0.1 against CrofAI's 0.08 / 0.003 / 0.1. On 254B tokens a week, 3% of measured traffic on this model, they bill $217.9K a year against the $320.0K the same workload would cost on CrofAI with CrofAI's typical 77% caching.
ℹ️ That 254B splits 24% input, 72% cached, 4% output, but spend breaks down 43% / 30% / 27% on OpenRouter vs 73% / 9% / 18% at CrofAI's current prices and caching.
